full_page.content:
1933, September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 146 Cont.
Sep. 24 Mrs. Schloss - 37 - Widow with five. .... Goiter
Mrs. Wm. Mauthic - 62 - Paralysis - wanted to come this p.m. - no gass.
Page 147
Sep. 26 Cath. Ryder - 42 - in Receiv. Hosp. nerv. break. Jos. Hickey - about 40 - Prov. Hosp. - pneum. Mrs. Naomi Hayes - 35 - Widow with 2 little ... . losing sight . ..... Hereditary sickness.
Wm. Williams - Presbit'n - 22 mos. of Bridgeport, Conn. - bright child & strong but born without pallet - had operation as possible to remedy Sept. 22nd at 12 time set for operation. Fr. S. in- scribed Child's name in S. Mass As'n at 1:20 p.m. - % McCall old friend of grandma. Same grandma writes with appreciative letter - by air mail - "operation successful."
28 Robert O'Brien - 82175 Penn'a - hopeless with diphtheria. Enrol- led at 3:15 P.M. perpetually. Oct. 2nd "Dr. Surprised" - boy out of danger. Went to sleep as father started for Monastery.
Baby Wm. McGarvey - 17 mo. of Windsor - Quite helpless fails even to notice - seem to know light from D ...
Wm. O'Neill - 14 - of Ont. - serious stomach trouble - his little brother - 4 - had 105 fever with mastoid & spinal maningitis with pneumonia .... phoned is O.K. again ....
30 Sr. Amantia (Fel) ... sinus 20 yrs ... Her superior - tumor on chest - She has 36 sister in charge - to have operation Monday, Oct. 2nd.
Dorothy Schwah - 15 mo. - eczema - scabs. ...
Geo. P. Webb - 57 - ulcers in stomach.
C.L. Hagel - 45 - hopelessly given to drink. Mother widow & con- vert, discouraged.
N. Urban - 12 of Grand Rapids - 50 1bs - had scarlet. .. Missions - Retreat.
